Henson et al. — Sheffield ORDA / Figshare lower-limb MR muscle segmentations
============================================================================

Sources (Day 4bi metadata-only fetch; **no** DICOM volumes in git):
  Labels DOI:  10.15131/shef.data.20440203
    https://orda.shef.ac.uk/articles/dataset/Augmented_images_associated_segmentations/20440203
  MR DOI:      10.15131/shef.data.20440164
  Registration inputs DOI: 10.15131/shef.data.21739733  (CC0)
  Multi-atlas code DOI:    10.15131/shef.data.21763982  (MIT)
  Paper: PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0273446

Licenses (Figshare API verified 2026-09-15):
  Labels + MR + registration inputs: **CC0** (public domain dedication)
  Multi-atlas MATLAB script: **MIT**

What is in git (tiny metadata / recipe only):
  read_me.txt                     — class ID legend (labels pack)
  mr_read_me.txt                  — MR companion readme
  registration_inputs_read_me.txt — registration RGB DICOM legend
  multi_atlas_read_me.txt         — multi-atlas usage notes
  multi_atlas_segmentation.m      — MIT multi-atlas fusion script (recipe)
  NOTICE.txt                      — this file

What is **not** in git:
  Any Aug_N_segmentations.dcm / Aug_N.dcm (~76–88 MB each; full labels ≈5.65 GB).
  See docs/henson-sheffield-sandbox-feasibility.md — sandbox may fetch **one**
  subject later; do **not** commit DICOM binaries.

Integration status: **NOT wired** to public/models/ or structures.json.
Masks ≠ elemental foot DI/NV GLBs; calf/thigh-heavy cohort; BP3D Kabsch unproven.
Prefer this research path over Andreassen similarity Kabsch retry (skipped).
